<a id="coordinates">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>coordinates</h4>
<pre>@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geocoordinates" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoCoordinates</a> coordinates</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The geographic coordinates of the location.</div>
</li>

<a id="bearingInDegrees">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>bearingInDegrees</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.Double bearingInDegrees</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Bearing (also known as course) is the device's horizontal direction of travel.
 Starts at 0 in the geographical north and rotates around the compass in a clockwise
 direction. This means for going north it is equal to 0, for northeast it is 45,
 for east it is 90 and so on. Note that this may be different from the orientation of
 the device. If it cannot be determined, the value is <code>null</code>. Otherwise, it is
 guaranteed to be in the range [0, 360).</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="speedInMetersPerSecond">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>speedInMetersPerSecond</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.Double speedInMetersPerSecond</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Current speed of the device. If it cannot be determined, the value is <code>null</code>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="time">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>time</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.util.Date time</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The time at which the location was determined.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="horizontalAccuracyInMeters">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>horizontalAccuracyInMeters</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.Double horizontalAccuracyInMeters</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The estimated horizontal accuracy. The actual location will lie within this radius of uncertainty.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="verticalAccuracyInMeters">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>verticalAccuracyInMeters</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.Double verticalAccuracyInMeters</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Estimated vertical accuracy.
 Given that the received Location contains the altitude, the real value of the altitude
 is estimated to lie within the following range:
 [altitude - vertical accuracy, altitude + vertical accuracy].
 For example, when the altitude is equal to 50 and the vertical accuracy
 is 8, then the actual value is most likely in the range [42, 58].</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="bearingAccuracyInDegrees">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>bearingAccuracyInDegrees</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.Double bearingAccuracyInDegrees</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Estimated bearing accuracy for this location, in degrees.
 If it cannot be determined, the value is <code>null</code>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="speedAccuracyInMetersPerSecond">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>speedAccuracyInMetersPerSecond</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;java.lang.Double speedAccuracyInMetersPerSecond</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Estimated speed accuracy of this location, in meters per second.
 If it cannot be determined, the value is <code>null</code>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="timestampSinceBoot">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>timestampSinceBoot</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-duration" title="class in com.here.time">Duration</a> timestampSinceBoot</pre>
<div class="block"><p>The time at which the location was determined, relative to device
 boot time. This time is monotonic and not affected by leap time or other system
 time adjustments, so this is the recommended basis for general purpose interval timing
 between location updates.
 If it cannot be determined, the value is <code>null</code>.</div>
</li>
</ul>

<div class="block"><p>Optional technology or provider of this location.
 If it cannot be determined, the value is <code>null</code>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="source">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>source</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-locationsource" title="enum in com.here.sdk.core">LocationSource</a> source</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Optional source of this location.
 If it cannot be determined, the value is <code>null</code>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="gnssTime">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>gnssTime</h4>
<pre>@Nullable
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-duration" title="class in com.here.time">Duration</a> gnssTime</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Optional gnss time at which the location was determined.
 It is a time interval from the Unix time epoch in milliseconds.
 If it cannot be determined, the value is <code>null</code>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
